headline: A man robbed two banks in broad daylight without a mask because he had rubbed lemon juice on his face and believed it made him invisible to cameras.
reveal: Real. Pittsburgh, 1995. Arrested hours after his face aired on the evening news, he reportedly protested that he'd worn the juice. His case inspired the study behind the Dunning–Kruger effect.

headline: A man under house arrest in Italy walked to the nearest police station and asked to be moved to prison instead, saying he could no longer stand living with his wife.
reveal: Real. Guidonia Montecelio, near Rome, 2021. He told the carabinieri that life at home had become unbearable and that jail would be better. A judge granted the transfer. The wife's side was not reported.

headline: After police posted a wanted man's photo online, he sent them a selfie with a message saying it was a better picture because the one they had used was terrible.
